risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI TEVV Security & Resiliency Assessment, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: Technical Verification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to perform Control Validation Testing (CVT) activities to evaluate the design, implementation and effectiveness of technical security, compliance and resilience controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Technical Verification (IAO-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of AI TEVV Security & Resiliency Assessment (AAT-28.5) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of AI TEVV Security & Resiliency Assessment (AAT-28.5) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
